description: Leaking bathtub supply pipe, discovered end of July after a few days of seeping. The whole bathroom floor (about 6 m² of tiling) was wet and had to be taken out and relaid. Water reached the living room through the shared wall: about 18 m² of laminate had to be removed and reinstalled together with the skirting, and the lower part of the living-room wall along the partition had to be prepared and repainted. Ceiling and hallway were both checked and were dry. Pipe repaired promptly; drying ran a few days before the trades started.

lines.1: Remove & reinstall water-damaged laminate incl. impact sound insulation and skirting boards, living room | 1 flat rate
lines.2: Remove & reinstall bathroom floor tiles incl. material and disposal | 1 flat rate
lines.3: Prepare & repaint water-damaged lower living-room wall | 20 m²
